snippet.title: METEOR STORM (1982) Walkthrough, ZX Spectrum
snippet.description:
Meteor Storm is an Asteroids style game. The story behind the game has the player, a member of the Falurian Empire, investigating an ancient relic that belonged to a race known as 'the People of Sphere' which is locked in a Trans-dimensional field. Things were going well until Xxkraan Raiders, aliens from Andromeda, attacked.

Their attack consisted of sending a swarm of asteroids at the player's ship with their own craft following them in. The player must fight for survival using their X-ray beam to shatter asteroids and slice open the enemy vessels.

The player has three ships / lives with which to survive the onslaught, each is equipped with a hyperspace jump to assist if local space gets too crowded. Points are awarded for asteroids shattered and enemy ships destroyed. Bonus ships are awarded every 10,000 points.

Released by Quicksilva in 1982.

Huge playlist archive with ZX Spectrum games from 1982: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLxOanVBhqd3uxyrkV_0f9h4YXKFLc062A
